Mirror image of a molecule with two stereocentres, checked with `frog-stereocenters`, and of a
small multi-structure file.

**Files used** (from the repository):

* `files/nmr_iPr.xyz` — C/H/O organic molecule with two stereocentres, 39 atoms
* `files/multi.xyz` — three 4-atom test structures with comment lines

**1. Write the enantiomer.**

```bash
frog-mirror files/nmr_iPr.xyz
```

```text
ℹ  Mirroring 1 structures from files/nmr_iPr.xyz
✔  Saved mirrored ensemble (1 structure): files/nmr_iPr_mirror.xyz
```

One structure in, one structure out: `files/nmr_iPr_mirror.xyz` is written next to the input.

**2. Check the configurations** of the original and of the mirrored file.

```bash
frog-stereocenters files/nmr_iPr.xyz files/nmr_iPr_mirror.xyz
```

```text
Stereocenters (files/nmr_iPr.xyz)
╭──────┬─────────┬───────────────╮
│ Atom │ Element │ Configuration │
├──────┼─────────┼───────────────┤
│    0 │ C       │ S             │
│    2 │ C       │ R             │
╰──────┴─────────┴───────────────╯
          Stereocenters
    (files/nmr_iPr_mirror.xyz)
╭──────┬─────────┬───────────────╮
│ Atom │ Element │ Configuration │
├──────┼─────────┼───────────────┤
│    0 │ C       │ R             │
│    2 │ C       │ S             │
╰──────┴─────────┴───────────────╯
```

```{figure} /_static/cli/frog-mirror/nmr_iPr.png
:width: 48%
:alt: files/nmriPr.xyz (xyzrender, hydrogens hidden, R/S labels from the 3D geometry).

`files/nmr_iPr.xyz` (xyzrender, hydrogens hidden, R/S labels from the 3D geometry).
```

```{figure} /_static/cli/frog-mirror/nmr_iPr_mirror.png
:width: 48%
:alt: nmriPrmirror.xyz, drawn in the same frame - x is inverted and every label is swapped.

`nmr_iPr_mirror.xyz`, drawn in the same frame: x is inverted and every label is swapped.
```

C0 is S in the input and R in the mirror image, C2 is R and becomes S: the mirrored file is the
enantiomer. In the drawings (same camera, no re-orientation) the molecule is flipped left–right.

**3. Multi-structure file into another folder.** Comment lines are copied unchanged.

```bash
frog-mirror files/multi.xyz --out-dir mirrored
```

```text
ℹ  Mirroring 3 structures from files/multi.xyz
✔  Saved mirrored ensemble (3 structures): mirrored/multi_mirror.xyz
```

`mirrored/multi_mirror.xyz`:

```text
4
Comment 1
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     0.000000
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     1.000000
 O    -1.000000     2.000000     0.000000
 F    -0.000000     1.000000     2.000000
4
Comment 2
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     0.000000
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     1.000000
 O    -1.000000     2.000000     0.000000
 F    -0.000000    -1.000000    -2.000000
4
Comment 3
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     0.000000
 H    -0.000000     0.000000     1.000000
 O    -1.000000     2.000000     0.000000
 F    -0.000000     1.000000     2.000000
```

The three structures keep their order and their comment lines (`Comment 1`, `Comment 2`,
`Comment 3`); only the sign of x changes (`-0.000000` is a zero coordinate with its sign inverted).
